request.tone: warm airship adventure with wonder and gentle humor; violence none, scariness mild, peril moderate
request.note: plan written by reading the finished book; no request text exists

pitch.hero: Bree, a girl who has always dreamed of the sky, stowed away aboard the airship Cirrus
pitch.want: to explore the sky-ship, then to help the frightened creature hidden in its sealed hold
pitch.obstacle: being caught as a stowaway, then a storm that terrifies the secret sky-whale calf and rocks the ship
pitch.stake: the Cirrus in the storm, the safety of Nimbus, and Bree's place aboard
pitch.ending_kind: storm weathered by gentleness, skill or honesty, or a kind put-ashore that leaves a clue

bree.name: Bree
bree.want: to fly, to stay hidden, and then to help Nimbus and the ship
bree.voice: close third past; brave, curious, polite, quietly funny

pip.name: Pip
pip.role: a thin grey stray cat; Bree's friend
pip.want: food and a friend her size
pip.voice: mrrp; purrs like a tiny engine once fed

nimbus.name: Nimbus
nimbus.role: a sky-whale calf hidden in the sealed hold; the secret
nimbus.want: to be calm, to fly, and to reach the haven
nimbus.voice: a long low hoooom; shakes when afraid

captain_quill.name: Captain Quill
captain_quill.role: captain of the Cirrus and keeper of the secret
captain_quill.want: to bring Nimbus safely to the haven without the crew or hunters knowing
captain_quill.voice: dry, quick, decisive; calls Bree Stowaway

bosun.name: the bosun
bosun.want: every line made fast and every hand known
bosun.voice: a foghorn; calls Bree small fry

rigger.name: the wiry rigger
rigger.role: rigger who keeps the rope-bridge and mends the envelope
rigger.want: the envelope mended and ropes respected
rigger.voice: practical; low and slow, ropes do not like to be rushed

first_officer.name: the first officer
first_officer.role: a tall woman, second in command
first_officer.want: to save the day the detour costs
first_officer.voice: brisk, grumbling, trying not to smile

cook.name: the cook
cook.role: galley cook who makes the cargo's mash

truth.question: What is the Cirrus secretly carrying, and what is rocking the ship in the storm?
truth.statement: Captain Quill is secretly carrying Nimbus, a sky-whale calf cut from a hunter's net, in the sealed deep hold of the Cirrus, kept warm and fed forty buckets of fish mash a day, bound east for the haven where his own kind live. The crew think they haul tea; the captain tells no one because hunters pay well for a sky-whale. Nimbus is terrified of thunder, and his thrashing rocks the ship; low, slow, gentle sound calms him.

bree_dreams_of_sky.text: A girl named Bree has dreamed about the sky for as long as she can remember.

airship_cirrus.text: The great airship Cirrus has just cast off from a mooring tower with Bree aboard.

captain_quill.text: Captain Quill commands the Cirrus; she has a dry, quick voice.

bree_is_stowaway.text: Bree is a stowaway aboard the Cirrus, first hidden in a coil of rope on the boarding deck.

bree_unnoticed.text: Nobody aboard has noticed Bree yet.

bree_has_ticket.text: Bree holds a ticket or paid passage aboard the Cirrus.

bree_no_ticket.text: Bree has no ticket, no cabin and no name in the purser's book.

four_ways_from_deck.text: Four ways lead off the boarding deck: the engine-room hatch, the cargo-hold ramp, the crow's nest ladder and the grand saloon.

stoker_sings.text: A big stoker shovels coal in the engine room and sings to the engine, calling it old girl.

engine_catwalk.text: A catwalk runs the long way round the engine room; the quicker open floor runs right behind the stoker.

dials_steam_lift_hold.text: A row of engine-room dials is labeled STEAM, LIFT and HOLD.

balloon_lifts_ship.text: A great balloon holds the airship up.

small_creature_in_bunkers.text: Something too small to be a sailor and too bold to be a mouse is scuffling in the coal bunkers.

hold_kept_warm.text: The HOLD dial points at WARM, and a chalked note says to keep it warm down there by order of the captain.
hold_kept_warm.implicit_plant: a warm hold foreshadows the living cargo revealed at n_secret

paw_prints.text: Tiny sooty paw prints lead from the coal bunkers through a loose hatch.

mew_heard.text: A small half-mew, half-chirp sound leads Bree through warm passages toward the middle of the ship.

nook_eyes.text: In a nook of coiled rope and spare canvas near the middle of the ship, two bright eyes watch Bree from behind a crate.

stoker_noticed.text: The stoker heard somebody crossing his engine room floor and began to turn.

stoker_fooled.text: The stoker put the noise down to tricks of the light and went back to shoveling.

caught_by_stoker.text: The stoker caught Bree carrying the ash bucket upside down and walked her to the purser.

purser.text: A thin purser keeps the ship's passenger ledger in his office and holds caught stowaways there until port.

sad_note_heard.text: A long, low, sad note hums up through the ship's wood, too sad to be an engine.

bree_put_ashore.text: Bree is set ashore when the Cirrus reaches port.

bree_stays_aboard.text: Bree stays aboard the Cirrus as one of the ship's own company.

bree_unaware_of_secret.text: Bree ends the voyage still wondering what the ship is secretly carrying.

forty_sacks_feed.text: The cargo hold carries forty sacks of feed, as if the ship were feeding a circus.

silver_crest_crates.text: A stack of crates in the hold is stamped with a silver crest.

grey_fur_tuft.text: A tuft of grey fur is caught on the rim of a barrel in the hold.

crest_sky_fish.text: The crest shows a silver fish with fins as wide as sails leaping over three curling clouds.

crates_haven_feed.text: The crested crates are stenciled HAVEN and FEED, 40 SACKS, and the feed smells like the sea.

rag_nest_sardine_tin.text: A nest of old rags with a licked-clean sardine tin shows that somebody small lives in the barrel tunnel.

crates_unlashed.text: Unlashed crates behind the loose netting shift and lean as the ship rolls.

grey_cat_rescued_bree.text: A thin grey cat found Bree boxed in by crates and fetched a deckhand to free her.

deckhand_chased_cat.text: A deckhand has chased the ship's grey stray cat for six weeks without catching it.

bree_does_not_know_cat_name.text: Bree does not know the name of the cat who helped her.

ladder_splits.text: The crow's nest ladder splits into a sheltered inner ladder and open outside rungs with a safety line and clip.

lookout_whistles.text: A lookout is whistling up in the crow's nest.

rope_run.text: A rope run marked RUN, HOLD TIGHT drops down through the mast.

balloon_gasbags.text: Inside the balloon's silver skin hang the gasbags that hold the ship up.

tired_seam.text: Near the stern, one seam of the balloon looks puckered and dark, like an old mend.
tired_seam.implicit_plant: foreshadows the envelope tear at n_bridge and b_patch1

mast_gust.text: On the open rungs a storm gust nearly shook Bree off the mast.

lookout_rescues.text: The lookout hauled Bree into the crow's nest, wrapped her in his coat and gave her cocoa.

ship_flying_heavy.text: The lookout says the ship is flying heavy in the belly this trip, as if a whale were aboard.

saloon_steward.text: A smooth steward serves the passengers in the grand saloon.

model_ships.text: A glass case behind the saloon curtains holds carved model ships, the biggest being the Cirrus.

lowest_deck_hidden.text: On the cut-open model of the Cirrus, the lowest deck's label has been painted over grey.
lowest_deck_hidden.implicit_plant: the painted-over deck foreshadows the sealed hold

bree_eats_crust.text: Bree ate a crust of bread from the stewards' pantry.

steward_caught_bree.text: The steward caught Bree bolting across the saloon and sat her in the purser's office with a bun and milk.

not_oddest_thing.text: The steward says Bree is not the oddest thing aboard this trip, but will not say what is.

pip_thin_grey_cat.text: A small, thin grey cat has been living on scraps aboard the Cirrus.

pip_named.text: Bree names the grey cat Pip, and he becomes her friend.

three_ways_from_nook.text: Three ways lead from the nook: toward the galley, to the captain's cabin door, and up a rope ladder into the inner rigging.

pip_in_coat.text: Bree carries Pip tucked inside her coat.

galley_cook.text: An enormous, grumbling cook runs the ship's galley.

mash_forty_buckets.text: The captain's cargo is fed forty buckets of fish mash a day.

pip_fed_sardines.text: Bree fed Pip a tin of sardines from the galley larder.

pip_purrs.text: Pip purrs, a rusty, rumbling purr like a tiny engine, once he has been fed.

pip_sneezed.text: Pip sneezed in the flour dust and the cook heard it.

cook_caught_bree.text: The cook caught Bree and Pip, fed them stew, and kept Pip on as galley cat.

pip_sardine_thief.text: Pip has been stealing the galley's sardines for six weeks.

storm_begins.text: A storm strikes the Cirrus: the floor lurches and a warning bell clangs.

officers_meeting.text: Captain Quill is in the officers' room next to her cabin and does not sound pleased.

captain_secret_he.text: Captain Quill speaks of a HE kept in a sealed hold, who has not eaten, hates thunder and loud noise, and could kick the ship to pieces.

crew_thinks_tea.text: The crew believe the Cirrus is hauling tea.

storm_chart.text: The captain's chart shows the ship's course bending wide around a storm.

whale_doodle_home_east.text: A pencil whale is drawn on the chart's corner with the word HOME and an arrow pointing east.
whale_doodle_home_east.implicit_plant: paid off at b_free_ok2, that is why we fly east

first_officer.text: The first officer is a tall woman with rain on her coat.

seasick_calf.text: The first officer grumbles at losing a day for the sake of one seasick calf.

nimbus_sketch.text: A pencil sketch of a small whale with fins like sails, labeled NIMBUS, is pinned under the chart table.

nimbus_officer_deflects.text: The first officer claims a nimbus is a kind of cloud.

inner_rigging.text: Inside the ship is the inner rigging, a warm forest of ropes strung between the decks near the gasbags.

rope_bridge_exists.text: A swaying rope-bridge in the inner rigging carries a sign: LIVE ROPE, CROSS LOW AND SLOW.

riggers_old_seam.text: The riggers say an old seam on the aft gasbag is the one that always goes.
riggers_old_seam.implicit_plant: foreshadows the envelope tear at n_bridge and b_patch1

bree_crossed_rope_bridge.text: Bree crossed the swaying rope-bridge low and slow in a gust, so she has crossed live rope.

rigger_saw_crossing.text: A rigger watched Bree cross the rope-bridge and whistled well done.

bree_never_crossed_live_rope.text: Bree has never crossed live rope in her life.

tangled_in_bridge.text: Bree rushed the rope-bridge, got tangled in its netting, and a rigger kept her clipped to his belt.

bosun.text: The bosun is an enormous man with a voice like a foghorn.

groan_from_hold.text: A long groan that does not sound like timber rises from the deep hold.

loose_line.text: A control line has torn loose on the weather deck and lashes about like a snake.

bree_caught_line.text: Bree caught the loose line and made it fast on a cleat.

officer_sends_below.text: A soaked officer sent Bree below and told her to find out what is groaning in the deep hold.

sealed_door.text: The deep hold is closed by a great door with a board saying SEALED BY ORDER OF THE CAPTAIN.

door_shaken_open.text: The storm shook the sealed door's bolt loose, leaving a gap just wide enough for Bree.

bree_hauled_rope.text: Bree threw her weight on the crew's rope and helped make it fast.

stowaways_go_to_purser.text: Caught stowaways are sent to the purser, whose office door locks.

bosun_asks_who.text: The bosun knows every hand aboard, does not recognise Bree, and asks who she is.

bosun_heard_confession.text: Bree told the bosun the truth, that she is a stowaway.

bosun_keeps_secret.text: The bosun promised not to have heard her confession until the storm ends and sent her to look in the sealed hold.

bree_kept_identity.text: Bree ducked away without telling the bosun who she is.

bosun_disbelieves.text: The bosun says he does not know Bree and will not believe her whale story.

bosun_believes_bree.text: The bosun believes Bree's whale story because she once told him the truth when a fib would have served her better.

crew_unaware.text: The crew, the bosun included, do not know what is in the sealed hold.

hold_creature_afraid.text: Something alive and afraid is groaning behind the sealed door.

hatch_window.text: The sealed door has a small round glass hatch, and a brass panel of handwriting hangs beside it.

pale_shape.text: Through the hatch, a huge pale shape longer than a lifeboat lies shaking and answers Pip with a low note.

nimbus_wears_harness.text: The creature in the sealed hold wears a harness with straps.

nimbus_calmed_softly.text: The creature must be calmed low and slow; shouting, banging and raised voices make him worse.

captain_tends_creature.text: Captain Quill wrote and signed the care orders for the creature in the sealed hold.

nimbus_sky_whale_calf.text: The secret in the sealed hold is a sky-whale calf, cloud-grey with fins like folded sails, filling the hold.

nimbus_named.text: The sky-whale calf is named Nimbus.

nimbus_rescued_from_net.text: Nimbus was cut from a hunter's net.

bound_for_haven.text: Nimbus is bound for the haven, where his own kind live.

captain_keeps_secret.text: Nimbus is Captain Quill's secret; the card by his door says TELL NO ONE.

nimbus_fears_thunder.text: Nimbus is frightened of the thunder.

nimbus_rocks_ship.text: When Nimbus flinches and thrashes, his body strikes the hull and rocks the whole ship.

nimbus_hums.text: Nimbus sings a long low hoooom, and the ship steadies when he does.

nimbus_answers_pip.text: Nimbus turns to Pip's mew and holds still for him.

bree_saw_nimbus.text: Bree has seen Nimbus with her own eyes.

harness_strap_pins_fin.text: One strap of Nimbus's leather harness is twisted tight around his left fin, pinning it flat.

three_note_song.text: Bree hums a made-up song of three notes going down like steps, and Nimbus hums it back.

fin_freed.text: Bree untangled the harness strap and freed Nimbus's fin.

fin_still_pinned.text: Nobody freed Nimbus's fin before the cargo door opened.

pip_calms_nimbus.text: Pip lay against Nimbus's nose and purred, and Nimbus went still.

gentle_company_steadies.text: Bree knows Nimbus steadies when someone small stays close and stays gentle.

captain_calls_stowaway.text: Captain Quill knows Bree is a stowaway and calls her Stowaway.

ship_losing_height.text: The Cirrus is dropping and losing height in the storm.

captain_knows_cause.text: Captain Quill knows the frightened Nimbus under their feet is what rocks the ship.

speaking_tube.text: A brass speaking tube runs from the wheelhouse straight down to Nimbus's hold.

envelope_tearing.text: The balloon envelope is tearing aft.

captain_ten_minutes.text: The captain needs Nimbus still for ten minutes so the ship can climb out of the storm.

loud_call_scares.text: Bree's shout down the speaking tube came out like thunder and set Nimbus thrashing.

storm_passes.text: The Cirrus comes safely out of the storm.

pip_purr_tube.text: Pip's purr, carried down the speaking tube, stopped Nimbus's booming.

pip_ships_cat.text: Pip is made ship's cat with a sardine ration for life.

tear_seam.text: A long tear has opened along one envelope seam, and only somebody small could fit past the ribs to it.

winch.text: A big iron winch pulls the patch-line tight from below.

bree_patched_tear.text: Bree climbed to the tear and threaded the patch-line, and the tear closed.

ships_boy_patched.text: Bree worked the winch while a thin ship's boy reached the tear, and the tear closed.

bree_stuck_rigging.text: Bree froze in the rigging during the storm, and the rigger had to leave the tear to fetch her.

berth_offered.text: Captain Quill offers Bree a berth on the Cirrus whenever she wants one.

cargo_door_torn.text: The storm has torn the hold's great cargo door half open onto the sky.

nimbus_wants_out.text: Nimbus is big enough to fly and wants out.

inner_bay.text: A padded, windowless inner bay opens off the hold.

captain_cannot_reach_harness.text: The captain has not been able to get near Nimbus's harness since the first thunder.

harness_removed.text: The captain slipped off Nimbus's harness at the cargo door.

nimbus_flies.text: Nimbus flew out into the storm on both fins, and the wind went gentle around him.

crew_sees_nimbus.text: The crew have seen Nimbus for themselves.

fly_east_reason.text: Nimbus is the reason the Cirrus flies east.

nimbus_reaches_haven.text: Nimbus reaches the haven and joins his own kind.

haven_keepers.text: The haven has keepers who care for sky-whales.

nimbus_in_bay.text: Nimbus rode out the storm calm in the padded inner bay.

nimbus_kite.text: With one fin pinned, Nimbus hung behind the ship on his harness line like a kite.

secret_kept_alive.text: The captain says the secret has kept Nimbus alive, because hunters pay well for a sky-whale and sailors talk in port.

crew_told.text: The crew have been told about Nimbus.

crew_doubt.text: The crew laughed at Bree's whale story and did not move.

captain_tells_crew.text: Captain Quill told the crew the secret herself.

n_open.event: Bree, a stowaway curled in a rope coil, is aboard the airship Cirrus as it casts off; Captain Quill calls the order.

n_start.event: Bree peeks out; four ways lead off the boarding deck and a sailor is coming her way.

a_eng1.event: The roaring engine room: a singing stoker, a long safe catwalk or a quick open floor behind him.

a_eng_deep.event: Among the pipes Bree finds dials marked STEAM, LIFT and HOLD and hears something small scuffling in the bunkers.

a_eng_a.event: The HOLD dial reads WARM, with a chalked order from the captain to keep it warm.

a_eng_a2.event: A snug passage; a curious mew answers Bree's hello and she follows it.

a_eng_b.event: In the coal bunkers Bree finds tiny paw prints leading to a loose hatch and a mew.

a_eng_b2.event: Bree follows the sooty prints along a warm service passage toward the mew.

a_eng_conv.event: In a nook of rope and canvas, bright eyes blink at Bree from behind a SAILCLOTH crate.

a_eng_risk.event: Halfway across the open floor the stoker hears her and turns; hide or bluff.

a_eng_recover.event: Hidden behind the coal chute, Bree waits until the stoker blames the light, then slips into the pipes.

e_set_eng.event: The stoker sees through the ash-bucket bluff; the purser holds ticketless Bree until port while a sad note hums through the wood.

b_hold1.event: The cargo hold: a deckhand grumbles about forty sacks of feed; a tidy aisle or loose netting.

b_hold_deep.event: Deep in the aisle: silver-crested crates and a barrel tunnel with grey fur on its rim.

b_hold_a.event: The crest is a sail-finned sky fish over clouds; the crates say HAVEN, FEED, 40 SACKS.

b_hold_a2.event: A small shape crosses the walkway, mews and chirps, and leads Bree on.

b_hold_b.event: In the barrel tunnel Bree finds a rag nest with a licked-clean sardine tin.

b_hold_b2.event: A half-mew, half-chirp leads Bree toward the middle of the ship past another sardine tin.

b_hold_conv.event: In a nook near the heart of the ship, two bright eyes open behind a crate.

b_hold_risk.event: Behind the netting, unlashed crates lean toward Bree; run clear or hide in a gap.

b_hold_recover.event: Bree scrambles clear, steadies a box, and returns to the tidy aisle.

e_set_hold.event: Boxed in by crates, Bree is freed when a thin grey cat fetches a deckhand; she is set ashore not knowing the cat's name.

c_nest1.event: The crow's nest ladder splits into a sheltered inner ladder and open rungs; someone whistles above.

c_nest_deep.event: Under the lookout's boots Bree finds a spare spyglass and a rope run.

c_nest_a.event: Through the spyglass Bree learns how the gasbags lift the ship and spots one tired, puckered seam near the stern.

c_nest_a2.event: In a sheltered gangway a curious half-mew, half-chirp draws Bree down a stair.

c_nest_b.event: Bree slides down the rope run out of the wind as the lookout calls after her.

c_nest_b2.event: A hopeful mew guides Bree along a warm passage toward the middle of the ship.

c_nest_conv.event: In a nook of rope and sail, patient shining eyes look at Bree from behind a crate.

c_nest_risk.event: A gust hits on the open rungs; catch the safety clip or scramble for the rail.

c_nest_recover.event: Clipped on, Bree rides out the gust and goes back to the sheltered ladder.

e_set_nest.event: The lookout hauls Bree in, warms her, and jokes the ship flies heavy as if carrying a whale; she is put down at port wondering.

d_salon1.event: The grand saloon at supper; nobody has noticed Bree; curtains or tablecloths.

d_salon_deep.event: Behind the curtains: a case of model ships and a STEWARDS ONLY door.

d_salon_a.event: The cut-open model of the Cirrus has its lowest deck painted over grey.

d_salon_a2.event: Down the stewards' hallway a half-mew, half-chirp draws Bree inward.

d_salon_b.event: In the pantry passage Bree eats a crust while the steward denies a mouse aboard.

d_salon_b2.event: A mew that seems to want bread leads Bree toward the middle of the ship.

d_salon_conv.event: In a nook of rope and sailcloth, hopeful bright eyes shine from behind a crate.

d_salon_risk.event: Under the tablecloths a waiter's boot nearly lands on Bree; trolley or door.

d_salon_recover.event: Bree rolls behind the trolley, then slips behind the curtains into a room.

e_set_salon.event: The steward catches Bree, feeds her a bun, and hints she is not the oddest thing aboard; she is set ashore wondering.

n_friend.event: A thin grey cat befriends Bree and she names him Pip; three ways lead on as boots begin to move.

f_galley1.event: The cook grumbles about forty buckets of fish mash for cargo; the larder is open, flour sacks offer cover.

f_galley_a.event: Bree feeds Pip sardines from the larder and he purrs for the first time; the floor lurches.

f_galley_b.event: Behind the flour sacks Pip sneezes and the cook turns; run or hold still.

f_galley_mid.event: The storm tips the corridor and a warning bell clangs; Bree tucks Pip into her coat and runs toward it.

e_set_galley.event: The cook catches Bree and Pip, names Pip the sardine thief, feeds them, mentions forty buckets for the captain's cargo; Bree is set ashore.

f_cabin1.event: The captain's cabin is empty; Captain Quill's voice comes from the officers' room.

f_cabin_a.event: Bree overhears the captain speak of a sealed hold's HE who fears thunder, and of a crew who think they haul tea; the bell rings.

f_cabin_b.event: The chart shows the course bending round a storm and a pencil whale marked HOME, east; boots approach.

f_cabin_b2.event: Hidden by the curtain, Bree hears the first officer grumble about one seasick calf before the bell sends her running.

f_cabin_mid.event: The corridor pitches and the bell clangs; Bree tucks Pip into her coat and follows the crew.

e_set_cabin.event: Caught under the chart table, Bree sees a whale sketch labeled NIMBUS; the officer calls it a cloud; Bree is sent ashore.

f_rig1.event: In the inner rigging Bree tests ropes; a steady catwalk or a LIVE ROPE bridge marked CROSS LOW AND SLOW.

f_rig_a.event: From the catwalk Bree hears riggers fret about the old seam that always goes as the first storm gust leans the ship.

f_rig_b.event: Halfway across the rope-bridge a gust kicks it sideways; inch low or run the last planks.

f_rig_b2.event: Low and slow, Bree crosses the bucking bridge; a watching rigger whistles well done.

f_rig_mid.event: The storm shakes the rigging; Bree tucks Pip into her coat and climbs down toward the shouting.

e_set_rig.event: Rushing the bridge, Bree is tangled in its netting; the rigger keeps her clipped to his belt, mutters about an old seam, and hands her down at port.

n_storm.event: The storm hits the main deck; the bosun calls all hands; a loose line, the hauling crew, or the groan from the deep hold.

s_deck1.event: On the weather deck a loose line lashes and an officer shouts; catch it or hold a rail post.

s_deck_a.event: Bree catches and makes fast the line; the officer sends her below to learn what groans in the deep hold.

s_deck_b.event: Clinging to the post, Bree sees a crate skid at her; the hatch or the far wheelhouse.

s_deck_mid.event: Following the groan down, Bree finds the sealed door shaken open by the storm.

e_set_storm1.event: A rigger catches Bree and wedges her in a safe cabin, where a sad note rises with the thunder all night and nobody explains it.

s_crew1.event: The crew strain on a balloon rope and the bosun demands hands and sand.

s_crew_a.event: Bree pulls with the crew and the rope is made fast; someone thumps her back.

s_crew_b.event: Lugging two sand buckets, Bree feels one tip as the deck tilts; keep going or drop them.

s_crew_mid.event: The bosun notices Bree and asks who she is; tell the truth or duck down the ladder.

s_crew_truth.event: The bosun laughs at Bree's confession, keeps it until the blow is done, and sends her to look in the sealed hold.

s_crew_dodge.event: Bree escapes the bosun with her name her own and follows the groan to the shaken-open sealed door.

e_set_storm2.event: Knocked down by the buckets, Bree is sat out of the way by the bosun, who wonders aloud what is in the sealed hold.

s_hold1.event: At the deep hold's sealed door the groan sounds alive and afraid; a glass hatch and a brass panel.

s_hold_a.event: Through the hatch, a vast pale shaking shape answers Pip with a low note.

s_hold_b.event: The captain's brass panel gives orders for feeding forty buckets of mash, checking harness straps, and calming low and slow.

s_hold_mid.event: Thunder jolts the sealed door open and Pip leads Bree inside.

n_secret.event: Inside is Nimbus, a sky-whale calf cut from a hunter's net and bound for the haven, the captain's secret; thunder makes him rock the ship, Pip's mew stills him.

p_save1.event: Close up, Bree sees a harness strap twisted around Nimbus's left fin; hum or untangle.

p_save_a.event: Bree makes up a three-note song and Nimbus hums it back, though the strap stays twisted.

p_save_b.event: Bree unbuckles the strap and frees Nimbus's fin; he stops jerking.

p_pip1.event: Pip, round with sardines, lies against Nimbus and purrs, and Nimbus goes still.

p_save_mid.event: Knowing Nimbus steadies with gentle company, Bree climbs to the wheelhouse to tell the captain.

p_reveal1.event: Racing to the bridge, Bree finds the main stair jammed; a long dry stair or a short flooded passage.

p_reveal_a.event: Climbing the long stair, Bree practices her news: the whale is scared of thunder and rocks the ship.

p_reveal_a2.event: Bree slips past a mate who says no passengers, truthfully saying she is not one.

p_reveal_mid.event: Bree bursts into the wheelhouse and tells the captain the whale is scared of thunder and rocking the ship.

e_set_reveal.event: The flooded passage turns Bree back; by the time she arrives the crew have levelled the ship the hard way, and the captain warms her.

p_people1.event: Bree runs to fetch help: the loud bosun at the mast or the captain who knows the hold's secret.

p_people_a.event: The bosun believes Bree because she told him the truth before, and leads her to the captain.

p_people_cold.event: The bosun does not know Bree and disbelieves her, but carries her to the captain anyway.

p_people_b.event: Bree tells the captain she has seen Nimbus; Captain Quill calls her Stowaway and takes her along.

p_people_mid.event: Bree and Pip come through the wheelhouse doors into the chaos of the bridge.

n_bridge.event: The ship drops, the envelope tears aft, the crew are in the dark; the captain names the speaking tube and asks Bree where she will stand.

b_steer1.event: At the speaking tube the captain asks for ten still minutes; thunder makes Nimbus boom.

b_steer_ok.event: Bree hums three low notes down the tube and Nimbus answers with a familiar hoooom; the ship answers the helm.

b_steer_ok2.event: Bree hums through the worst of it until the Cirrus rises into calm moonlit air.

e_set_final.event: Bree's shout down the tube sounds like thunder; Nimbus thrashes, the crew win the hard way, and the captain walks Bree ashore.

e_win_save_ship.event: The captain thanks Bree for forty minutes, not ten, calls her one of the ship's own, and Nimbus later reaches the haven.

b_steer_purr.event: Bree holds full-of-sardines Pip to the tube and his purr calms Nimbus.

e_win_purr.event: Pip purrs for an hour, the ship climbs out of the storm, Pip is made ship's cat and Bree his keeper aboard.

b_patch1.event: Under the envelope a long tear needs someone small; the rigger asks if Bree has crossed live rope; climb or work the winch.

b_patch_ok.event: Bree says she crossed a rope-bridge tonight; the rigger recognises her and she climbs and threads the patch.

b_patch_alt.event: Bree cranks the winch while a ship's boy reaches the tear, and the tear closes.

e_win_patch.event: The patch holds; the riggers credit Bree, and the captain signs her on as rigger's mate.

e_win_steer.event: Steady lift wins; the crew carry Bree, and the captain offers her a berth and thanks her for her cargo.

e_set_aloft.event: Never having crossed live rope, Bree freezes in the rigging; the ship limps to an emergency mooring; a rope-bridge could have taught her.

b_free1.event: In the hold the captain says Nimbus wants out; the cargo door is torn open, she cannot reach that harness, and a padded inner bay waits.

b_free_ok.event: Bree says she freed his fin; the captain drops the harness and Nimbus rises out of the cargo door on both fins.

b_free_ok2.event: Nimbus calms the storm around him and circles the ship; the crew see him; the captain says he is why they fly east.

e_win_free.event: Nimbus leads the Cirrus to the haven and joins his kind; the captain credits the freed fin and offers Bree a berth.

b_free_alt.event: Bree hums Nimbus into the padded inner bay and the thrashing stops.

e_win_friend.event: Bree stays with Nimbus in the bay all night; at the haven the keepers marvel, and Nimbus joins his kind.

e_neu_kite.event: With one fin still strapped, Nimbus flies behind the ship like a kite; the haven must wait a week while keepers rest his fin.

b_tell1.event: Bree says the crew should know; the captain says the secret has kept Nimbus alive from hunters.

b_tell_crew.event: Bree tells the crew; the bosun vouches for her because she confessed to him, and everyone runs to help.

e_win_crew.event: The port watch hums Nimbus through the night; the crew make Bree a shipmate and the captain salutes her.

b_tell_doubt.event: The crew laugh at Bree's whale and the bosun says he does not know her; nobody moves.

b_tell_captain.event: The captain tells the crew herself, then offers Bree a hard place at Nimbus's side or a warm bunk.

e_win_captain.event: Bree hums beside Nimbus with the captain all night, and the captain writes her into the log as crew.

e_neu_home.event: Bree sleeps through the end of the storm, having looked a sky-whale in the eye, and leaves at port invited back.

b_tell_reveal.event: Bree drags the bosun and crew down to the hold; seeing Nimbus, they sit and hum.

e_win_discovery.event: Forty crew voices hum Nimbus through; the cook learns where his forty buckets go; the captain asks Bree to sail with them.

payoff_sites.shows: Pip, round with sardines, lies against Nimbus and purrs him still.
A full cat purrs down the speaking tube and the purr calms Nimbus.
Having crossed live rope, Bree climbs to the tear and patches it.
Without that crossing, Bree freezes in the rigging like a burr.
The bosun believes Bree because she told him the truth.
A stranger's whale story is not believed by the bosun.
The bosun vouches for Bree and the whole crew runs to help.
The crew laugh and the bosun says he does not know her.
With his fin free, Nimbus flies out of the cargo door on both fins.
With one fin still strapped, Nimbus can only hang behind the ship like a kite.

e_set_eng.gift: a sad note through the wood hints at a living secret; the hidden catwalk was the patient way

e_set_hold.gift: a nameless grey cat rescues her, a reason to come back and learn his name

e_set_nest.gift: the lookout's whale joke is closer to the truth than he knows

e_set_salon.gift: a bun, a kind steward, and the hint that something odder rides aboard

e_set_galley.gift: Pip finds a home as galley cat, and forty buckets a day hint at hungry cargo

e_set_cabin.gift: a whale sketch named NIMBUS that the officer pretends is a cloud

e_set_rig.gift: the rigger's rule: low and slow, ropes do not like to be rushed

e_set_storm1.gift: a sad note rising with the thunder; the answer was under the nearby hatch

e_set_storm2.gift: even the bosun longs to know what groans in the sealed hold

e_set_reveal.gift: the captain's warm word: a slow messenger still arrives, a wet one mostly sneezes

e_set_final.gift: a loud voice is thunder to a frightened whale; softness was the key

e_win_save_ship.gift: Bree's soft humming saves the ship and makes her one of its own

e_win_purr.gift: the fed cat's purr saves the ship; Pip and Bree both stay aboard

e_win_patch.gift: rope learned on the bridge lets Bree mend the envelope and sign on as rigger's mate

e_win_steer.gift: hard work at the winch saves the ship and earns her a berth

e_set_aloft.gift: ropes are learned in calm air; the rope-bridge was there to teach her

e_win_free.gift: the freed fin lets Nimbus fly home and lead the ship out of the storm

e_win_friend.gift: a calm night together in the padded bay and a farewell at the haven

e_neu_kite.gift: a whale kite and a laugh, and the lesson that one twisted strap mattered

e_win_crew.gift: honesty with the bosun turns the whole crew into Nimbus's helpers and Bree into a shipmate

e_win_captain.gift: standing by Nimbus with the captain earns Bree her name in the log as crew

e_neu_home.gift: a real sky-whale seen with her own eyes and an invitation to come back taller

e_win_discovery.gift: the secret becomes a wonder the whole crew shares, and Bree sails on with them

notes: Read-only route walk: b_free1 says that harness, but the harness is shown only at s_hold_b or p_save1; routes via p_pip1, p_reveal1 or p_people1 that skipped the panel never saw it.
Read-only route walk: e_win_discovery has the cook say my forty buckets; the forty buckets of mash are stated only at f_galley1, e_set_galley or s_hold_b, so most routes never saw them.
bree_has_ticket is declared only as the opposite that bree_no_ticket and bree_not_passenger contradict; no passage establishes it.
Setback endings that only imply landing at port (e_set_storm1, e_set_storm2, e_set_reveal, e_set_aloft) are not given bree_put_ashore; endings that say so are.
